Top candidate "Storage Schema & Migration Infrastructure" constraints (verify the Feature match before relying on these):
  · Single clean baseline migration from schema.ts as source of truth — the broken migration chain will not be reconstructed.
  · WS-A owns all schema and migrations; downstream workstreams build against a pinned contract and must not touch the schema.
  · The 26 pre-existing tsc errors are the binding baseline — all new work must add zero net-new errors.
  · Legacy events are mapped at read time and never backfilled — mutating history to fit today's vocabulary is rejected.
  · Topic subsystem is excised; schema is Feature-centric.
